dndSources.label: Character content sources
dndSources.device: SRD and players’ own expansion packs
dndSources.deviceGm: SRD, players’ own expansion packs and the GM’s homebrew
dndSources.gmHint: When you save, the entries you tick below are copied to this table for everyone at it.

dndShare.heading: Homebrew on this table
dndShare.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the homebrew for this table.
dndShare.guest: Guest accounts can’t bring homebrew to a table. Register an account to share your entries.
dndShare.empty: You have no D&D homebrew yet. Create entries in My homebrew, then come back to tick them.
dndShare.refreshHint: The table keeps the version it copied. Press Update on the table and save to bring the newer versions.
dndShare.dirtyHint: When you save, every ticked entry is copied again at its current version.
dndShare.deletedHint: The table keeps these until you remove them. Saving any change to your entries removes them too.
dndShare.links: “{from}” mentions your homebrew “{to}”, which isn’t shared. Players see the name without its text.

removeOther.title: Remove {name}’s homebrew from this table?
removeOther.description: New characters can no longer pick these entries. Text already on character cards stays.

untick.title: Stop using the GM’s homebrew?
untick.owner: When you save, everyone’s homebrew leaves this table. Text already on character cards stays.
untick.assistant: When you save, your homebrew leaves this table. Others’ stays, but this table no longer shows it.

errors.signIn: Sign in again to bring homebrew to the table.
errors.guest: Guest accounts can’t bring homebrew to a table.
errors.forbidden: Only the table owner and GM assistants can bring homebrew, and only the owner can remove someone else’s.
errors.conflict: Your homebrew on this table just changed somewhere else. It’s reloaded and your ticks are kept: save again to use them.
errors.invalid: An entry can’t be shared (it may have just been deleted). Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalidEntry: “{name}” can’t be shared (it may have just been deleted, moved to another system, or clash with an identical entry). Reload the page and try again.
errors.duplicate: “{first}” and “{second}” are the same entry (same kind and id, from different packs). A table takes only one: untick one, then save again.
errors.limitItems: Too many entries for one table (300 across everyone). Untick some, then save again.
errors.limitBytes: Too much text for one table (1 MiB across everyone). Untick some, then save again.
errors.network: Can’t connect right now. Your ticks are kept: save again later.
